after.stage: Earlier T03 working-tree measurement; retained separately from the final control.

final_control.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python examples/benchmark_builtin_native.py --label final-control --backends auto python --output ../t03_cpu_control.json

benchmarks.interpretation: Retain all original samples. Shared-host load drift prevents treating cross-time wall ratios as precise portable speedups. Process CPU time removes scheduling waits but not frequency/cache/memory contention.

scope_checks.native_cayley_changes: one include and one method export

limitations: Composed velocity-Verlet thermostats retain existing capability restrictions.
Cell-aware composed C ABI v1 cannot supply cell/virial; fixed-cell ordinary cosine blocks are supported.
Frame-dependent harmonic parameters, subclasses, evaluator overrides and stateful/coupled providers decline implicit binding.
An unprimed PythonPotential wrapper retains its no-argument atom-count limitation; direct built-ins are shape-aware.
Matrix/diabatic/nonadiabatic model families remain future work.
Local build and tests cover Linux only; timing/parity do not establish physical convergence.

publication.note: The six code/documentation commits were recreated with identical Git tree hashes. Commit metadata differs. The final evidence commit adds this provenance mapping only.
